purpose: Search entry points and extraction guidance for the irshop agent. URL templates and selector hints are starting points, not a guarantee that a site currently exposes that route or markup.

query_rules.encoding: Percent-encode the complete query value as UTF-8 before substituting {query}. If the template fails, use the visible search form on the site's home page.
evidence_priority: Rendered product/offer page and visible selected variant
Product or Offer JSON-LD validated against the rendered page
Rendered search-result card with product-specific price and URL
Search snippet only for discovery; not enough to assert stock or final price

generic_extraction.product_jsonld: Inspect script[type='application/ld+json'] for Product, Offer, or AggregateOffer. Read name, sku, offers.price, offers.priceCurrency, offers.availability, offers.seller, and offers.url when present.
generic_extraction.card_association: Find the product anchor first. Extract the price and stock text from the same card/container, not from a nearby promotional banner or unrelated product.
generic_extraction.price: Prefer current selling price. Ignore crossed-out prices, installments, deposits, delivery charges, and conditional coupon totals.
generic_extraction.stock: Only mark in_stock or out_of_stock when explicit page evidence exists. Otherwise use unknown.
generic_extraction.selectors_warning: Do not treat any selector hint as verified or stable. Inspect the live DOM on every site visit and prefer semantic attributes and structured data.

shops.name: ترب

selector_hints.price: Read price text in the same result card as the matching product link; confirm the relevant seller/offer on the product page.
selector_hints.availability: Do not infer merchant stock from a Torob price alone; prefer an explicit seller offer state or verify the linked shop.

extraction_notes: Always search Torob first.
Open the matching Torob product page and inspect the individual seller offers.
Treat each distinct seller/price combination as a separate comparison offer.
If there is no verified merchant URL, link to the exact Torob product page and name Torob as the source.
Aggregator prices can be stale or lead to a different variant; verify the seller page when accessible.

shops.name: دیجی‌کالا

selector_hints.price: Read the current price on the product page for the exact selected variant; inspect visible price labels and Product/Offer JSON-LD.
selector_hints.availability: Inspect visible stock messaging and the active purchase control for the exact selected variant.

extraction_notes: Product paths and client-rendered attributes may change; use hrefs found in the current DOM.
Confirm storage, color, model, seller, warranty, and condition before accepting an offer.
Do not treat a generic add-to-cart button elsewhere on the page as evidence for this product.

shops.name: باسلام

selector_hints.price: Read the price next to the matching product title in the rendered card or product page.
selector_hints.availability: Use an explicit stock message or active purchase control belonging to the exact offer.

extraction_notes: Use basalam.com as the site host and follow only product links found on the current page.
If the saved search URL no longer works, use the site's visible search field and record the resulting product URL.
Record the seller/booth name only if it is visible on the page.
Do not infer shipping cost, delivery time, or free shipping.

shops.name: ایمالز

product_links: Inspect anchors inside the matching rendered result card; no fixed path is assumed.
selector_hints.price: Associate each displayed price with its product variant and, if shown, seller/offer.
selector_hints.availability: Verify on the merchant's product page if eMalls does not explicitly expose stock.

extraction_notes: Open the home page and use the visible search form rather than guessing a query parameter.
Follow a merchant offer when available and accessible.
When only the aggregator offer is verifiable, link to that specific eMalls page and label it clearly.
Do not assume an offer is in stock merely because a price is listed.

shops.name: الکترومیک
extraction_notes: These are WooCommerce-style candidates only; confirm they exist before using them.
If the search route fails, use the website's visible search form.
On the product page, inspect Product/Offer JSON-LD and visible stock text.

shops.name: آرویدتک
extraction_notes: Check the current DOM first; WooCommerce-like selectors are fallback hints, not verified selectors.
Use only listed price values for the same model/variant and verify currency from the page.

shops.name: میکرومیک
extraction_notes: Check whether the current site uses WooCommerce before using the candidate selectors.
Find the product-specific price and stock status in the same card or detail page.
If the product page gives no stock evidence, use unknown.

shops.name: کافه ربات
extraction_notes: Use for robotics components, kits, education boards, and related products.
Candidate selectors are not guarantees; verify them on the live DOM.
Confirm that kit contents and quantities match before comparing prices.

output_policy.sort: verified in-stock offers first, then ascending normalized Toman price

unsupported_features.note: Do not promise these features unless an independent, working tool implements them.
